requirements.statement: Bind DNS findings to the exact current Cloudflare DNS documentation snapshot and declared zone scope.
requirements.evidence: Zone, record, provider, and source-lock receipt.

requirements.statement: Do not transfer DNS semantics to another edge provider or infer account authority.

applicability_rule: Applicability is evaluated from external jurisdiction/entity/activity/data/version/effective-date evidence; this file never stores project facts.
exception_rule: Exceptions require an external primary-source or authority-corpus reference and remain requirement-level mappings.
